en: Color image showing a planned residential district with mid‑rise modernist apartment blocks arranged around landscaped green courtyards and curving paths. The buildings are simple rectangular structures with balconies and small decorative square insets on the façades. In the foreground is a cone‑shaped glass pavilion attached to a low building. The background shows rolling green hills dotted with small houses under a partly cloudy sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
